_comment: Паспорта типовых стилей интерьера (Ф0 плана sets-style-v3). score.* — веса признаков для подбора товаров (образец владельца: 'доля влияния на узнаваемость'); prompt — блок для генерации ремонта под стиль (товары НЕ меняются); clip — фразы zero-shot. Источники: t-j.ru/list/interior-styles, netology.ru/blog/09-2022-top-20-interior-styles, domovita.by (джапанди/лофт/сканди), ivd.ru (джапанди), vc.ru стили-2025, vm.ru (топ Москвы).

сканди.признаки: светлое дерево 25% · простые лаконичные формы 20% · светлые нейтрали (белый/беж/серый) 15% · уютный текстиль (рогожка, вязаное, пледы) 15% · чёрные/деревянные ножки-опоры 10% · декоративность-хюгге (свечи, постеры, растения) 10% · редкие приглушённые акценты 5%
clip: scandinavian style light wood furniture, simple clean lines
cozy nordic hygge interior piece, pale oak and white
сканди.prompt: RENOVATE the room in SCANDINAVIAN style: walls painted warm white or pale grey matte, light oak plank flooring, white ceiling, simple white window frames with airy white linen curtains, black-framed art prints and small gallery wall, a couple of green potted plants, warm cozy daylight, white panel radiator. Simple skirting, no mouldings, no gloss, no gold.
decor_examples: пара зелёных растений в простых кашпо
сканди.render_guide:
SCANDINAVIAN STYLE — warm Nordic home.
WALLS: smooth matte paint in warm white with a faint cream or pale-greige undertone; one wall may be a slightly deeper warm greige; no wallpaper, no stripes.
FLOOR: pale natural oak or ash planks, matte, honey-light tone with calm grain.
TRIM & DOOR: simple flat white skirting and plain white trim; if the door is a schematic placeholder, make it a plain white painted door with a flat frame.
LIGHT: bright, soft, slightly warm window daylight with a gentle golden cast, soft long shadows, airy, not dim.
CEILING LIGHT: one broad, shallow Nordic pendant in matte off-white metal with a small pale-oak detail and an opal diffuser; medium in scale, close to the ceiling at the room's central ceiling point, switched off.
WINDOW DRESSING: floor-length light linen curtains in cream or oatmeal on a thin black or natural-wood rod, hung high and wide, slightly open.
ART & DECOR: one or two black-framed prints with a white mat (botanical line drawing, muted abstract or black-and-white photo) hung at eye level; one green plant in a plain white or terracotta pot; nothing more.
STYLE NO: gloss, gold, ornament, bold patterns, cold grey walls, clutter.

clip: contemporary modern furniture, clean neutral design with accent colour
современный.prompt: RENOVATE the room in CONTEMPORARY style: smooth matte walls in warm greige with one deeper accent wall, wide oak-tone laminate flooring, minimal white ceiling with recessed spots plus the ceiling light, straight-line curtains floor to ceiling, large abstract framed art, a sculptural plant, balanced warm lighting, white panel radiator. Crisp clean detailing, no classical mouldings.
современный.render_guide:
CONTEMPORARY STYLE — clean, warm, confident.
WALLS: perfectly smooth matte paint in warm greige or soft taupe; optionally the wall behind the sofa or the TV in a deeper muted tone (graphite, olive, clay or navy-grey), flat colour without panels.
FLOOR: wide engineered-oak planks in a warm mid tone, matte, or large-format matte warm-grey stone-look tiles.
TRIM & DOOR: slim flat skirting painted white or in the wall colour, crisp straight lines; a schematic door becomes a flat slab door in the wall colour with a slim black handle.
LIGHT: clean, even daylight with soft defined shadows; neutral-to-warm.
CEILING LIGHT: one low-profile sculptural hoop ceiling fixture with a slim matte-black frame and an opal diffuser; medium-wide, crisp and visually light, close to the ceiling at the room's central ceiling point, switched off.
WINDOW DRESSING: floor-to-ceiling plain linen-look curtains in sand or graphite on a slim ceiling track, or a plain roller blind; no patterns.
ART & DECOR: one large abstract canvas or a diptych in a slim black or oak frame carrying the room's single accent colour (burnt orange, navy or olive), centred over the sofa or on the free wall; one sculptural plant in a matte ceramic pot.
STYLE NO: classical mouldings, rustic textures, chrome glitz, pastel colours, patterned wallpaper, clutter.

минимализм.признаки: минимум деталей и декора 30% · гладкие фасады без ручек 20% · монохромная светлая гамма 20% · простые геометрные силуэты 15% · скрытые/встроенные решения 10% · фактура вместо орнамента 5%
clip: minimalist furniture, plain smooth surfaces, no decoration
минимализм.prompt: RENOVATE the room in SOFT MINIMALIST style: perfectly smooth matte walls in one light warm tone (off-white/greige), seamless pale microcement-look or wide light plank floor, flat white ceiling with a discreet light line, full-height plain curtains in the wall colour, at most ONE large calm artwork, one architectural plant, lots of clean empty surface, diffused soft light, flat white radiator. No mouldings, no patterns, no clutter.
минимализм.render_guide:
SOFT MINIMALIST STYLE — warm, quiet, uncluttered.
WALLS: one continuous light warm tone (warm off-white or pale greige) in a perfectly smooth matte or fine lime-plaster finish; no accent wall.
FLOOR: seamless pale wide-plank wood with a matte finish, or light warm microcement; no pattern.
TRIM & DOOR: skirting flush with the wall or a thin shadow gap, practically invisible; a schematic door becomes a flush door painted the wall colour with a minimal handle.
LIGHT: soft, diffused, even daylight with low contrast and barely visible shadows; no harsh sun patches.
CEILING LIGHT: one broad ultra-shallow flush-mount disc in matte warm white with a seamless opal diffuser; quiet and nearly flush with the ceiling, centred in the room, switched off.
WINDOW DRESSING: wall-to-wall sheer off-white linen from ceiling to floor on a hidden track, or a plain roller blind.
ART & DECOR: at most one oversized muted artwork (abstract canvas or monochrome photograph) in a hair-thin frame, or none; at most one architectural plant in a plain pot; large empty surfaces are intended.
STYLE NO: patterns, colour accents, gloss, ornament, groups of small objects, visible clutter.

No classical mouldings, nothing glossy or gilded.

лофт.render_guide:
INDUSTRIAL LOFT STYLE — warm brick, concrete and dark steel.
WALLS: the wall behind the sofa or the TV as exposed red-brown brick with natural sandy mortar; the other walls smooth warm-grey concrete-look matte plaster or deep graphite paint.
FLOOR: wide dark-stained wood planks with visible grain, matte, or warm grey polished concrete.
TRIM & DOOR: flat dark or black skirting with hard straight edges; a schematic door becomes a dark-painted door with a dark frame.
LIGHT: warm afternoon daylight raking across the brick, a little moodier contrast than usual, but every piece of furniture clearly lit.
CEILING LIGHT: one broad shallow factory pendant in matte blackened steel with a dark canopy and a simple open underside; medium-large but visually spare, on a very short drop at the room's central ceiling point, switched off.
WINDOW DRESSING: heavy charcoal or rust linen curtains on a black pipe rod, hung loosely, or no curtains.
ART & DECOR: one large monochrome photographic poster or a vintage industrial print in a thin black frame; one tall green plant in a concrete or black metal pot.
STYLE NO: gloss, gold, classical mouldings, pastel colours, floral patterns, glossy white doors.

clip: neoclassical elegant furniture, tufted velvet, brass details
classic refined interior piece, symmetric panelled design
неоклассика.prompt: RENOVATE the room in NEOCLASSICAL style: walls in soft cream or grey-beige matte with elegant rectangular wall mouldings (panel frames), white ceiling with a discreet cornice and a ceiling rosette under the chandelier, herringbone parquet floor, tall curtains with an elegant drape, classical framed paintings, a large mirror in a refined frame, orchid or elegant plant, warm golden evening-like light, white classic-panel radiator. Symmetry matters. No exposed brick, no industrial elements.
неоклассика.render_guide:
NEOCLASSICAL STYLE (modern classic) — light, proportioned, refined.
WALLS: smooth matte paint in soft cream, warm greige or dusty grey-blue; slim white rectangular panel mouldings laid out in a calm symmetrical rhythm on the main walls; no heavy stucco.
FLOOR: natural oak herringbone parquet in a light-to-mid honey tone, matte.
TRIM & DOOR: white ceiling with a simple plain cornice, taller profiled white skirting and white architraves; a schematic door becomes a white panelled door with classic profiles and a brass handle.
LIGHT: warm golden daylight, soft and elegant, gentle highlights on the mouldings.
CEILING LIGHT: one compact shallow symmetrical chandelier with slender aged-brass arms and small clear-glass shades, beneath a discreet plain ceiling rose; refined rather than ornate, on a short drop at the room's central ceiling point, switched off.
WINDOW DRESSING: full-length heavy curtains in cream, champagne or dusty blue with soft folds on a simple rod or ceiling track, with a sheer white inner layer; no swags or tassels.
ART & DECOR: one classical framed painting (landscape or still life) or a symmetrical pair of framed prints in dark-wood or antique-gold frames, or one framed mirror; a white orchid in a ceramic cachepot. Symmetry guides mouldings, art and curtains only — never the furniture.
STYLE NO: columns, baroque ornament, gold overload, glossy stretch ceilings, dark heavy wallpaper, palace or hotel look.

джапанди.prompt: RENOVATE the room in JAPANDI style: walls in warm sand/clay limewash-look matte (subtle, even), light tatami-tone wood floor, minimal white-warm ceiling, simple linen curtains, one or two ink-style or botanical artworks, a bonsai or sculptural branch in a ceramic vase, a paper or rattan pendant feel of light — soft, low-contrast warm daylight, discreet white radiator. Low visual noise, rounded corners, wabi-sabi calm. No gloss, no gold, no bright colours.
джапанди.render_guide:
JAPANDI STYLE — warm, serene, wabi-sabi.
WALLS: limewash-look or fine textured plaster in warm sand, clay or mushroom, soft and even with subtle hand-finished variation; no accent colours, no wallpaper.
FLOOR: light natural ash or oak planks with a matte finish; any darker wood in trim or door reads as walnut or smoked oak.
TRIM & DOOR: minimal low trim in the wall colour or thin natural-wood skirting; a schematic door becomes a flat natural-oak or walnut veneer door with a small black handle.
LIGHT: soft, warm, filtered daylight as if through paper screens, low contrast, calm shadows.
CEILING LIGHT: one broad flattened washi-paper lantern with a fine pale-wood or bamboo frame, warm off-white, handcrafted and visually light; close to the ceiling at the room's central ceiling point, switched off.
WINDOW DRESSING: raw natural linen curtains in oatmeal on a thin wooden rod, or a bamboo or paper-look roller blind.
ART & DECOR: one ink-wash or botanical piece in a thin natural-wood frame, slightly off-centre, or none; one live plant with a simple branch-like silhouette in a handmade ceramic pot, or a wooden bowl; few objects, asymmetric, with visible craft.
STYLE NO: gloss, gold, bright colours, forced symmetry, plastic, clutter, red-toned wood.

compat_prompt_note: Каждый prompt-блок ДОПОЛНЯЕТ базовые правила pipeline2 (товары неизменны: форма/цвет с фото; декор ≤90 см; стены идеально чистые матовые; батарея под окном).

_decor_policy._why: Что модели запрещено ДОБАВЛЯТЬ в кадр при ремонте. Живёт здесь, рядом со стилями, потому что набор зависит от стиля и меняется вместе с ним. Текст АНГЛИЙСКИЙ: он подставляется в англоязычный промпт, и смешивать языки в одном запросе нельзя.
deny_always: any lighting other than the single ceiling fixture: recessed or track lights, spotlights, sconces, floor or table lamps, LED strips, luminous ceilings or ceiling coves
electronics other than the existing television
objects that overlap or displace existing products
cushions, throws or armrests that the catalogue product does not have
_decor_policy.allow_hint: модель выбирает сама и вправе не добавлять ничего, если станет захламлённо

allow_now.curtains or blinds: владелец 02.09 снял прежний запрет: «явно дай разрешение шторы генерить под стиль, он все без штор делает». Шторы — часть отделки окна, а не товар из сметы; модель подбирает их под стиль. Прежняя причина запрета (01.09: «шторы бывают разные, пока не добавили как ТОВАР — не выдумывать») отменена владельцем.
allow_now.one style-matched ceiling fixture in pla: владелец 22.10 (TG 830–836): «стрёмная выключенная люстра» на фото — это белый плафон-заглушка 3D-сцены (`lib/viewer3d/fixtures-ir.ts:ceilingLampIR`); «прописать стиль люстры под каждый стиль». Строка CEILING LIGHT в каждом `render_guide`, общий блок CEILING FIXTURE в `improve_mode.py:prompt_for`; прочий свет и второй светильник — в `deny_always`. Люстра пока не товар сметы (как шторы); позже — товар с мешем (план demo-20 Г4, разбор Codex `_intake/codex/demo20-chandelier-2026-10-22-answer.md`).

_render_guide_about: STYLE GUIDE для режима «улучшить фото»: ЕДИНСТВЕННЫЙ переменный блок промпта, всё остальное статично (структура владельца 01.09). Текст СОВЕТУЮЩИЙ, а не список обязательного: модель берёт то, что подходит комнате, и опускает лишнее; статические запреты он не отменяет. Исключение — строка CEILING LIGHT: она обязательна и задаёт единственный новый светильник, потолочный, вместо белого плафона-заглушки сцены (владелец 22.10, блок CEILING FIXTURE в `improve_mode.py`). Поле `prompt` рядом НЕ годится для этого режима — оно писалось для сцены с нуля (шторы, люстра, «розетка под люстру» и прочий свет без общих запретов).
